## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 2, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mirand888_, Jun 2, 2026, 3/5: "Idea is good but the application is annoying to use. App keeps crashing all the time and is very slow to use."
            2. _Kate is typing.._, Jul 26, 2026, 5/5: "This app single-handedly saved my mental health. For reference, I’m a first-generation college student, with a narcissistic mother, battling between navigating college and work while also trying my hardest to appease my family by walking on egg shells. After 19 years of mental, psychological, and verbal abuse, it gets to you. I’d neglect my hygiene, isolate myself from friends, and was always combative because I really felt like I was in a mental cage. This app starts small. It lets you take baby steps, as your birb grows WITH you when you complete tasks of your choosing. It can be basic hygiene like taking a daily shower, or even work productivity if you’re feeling up for it. You decide what you want to do, and how much you’re willing to do and works with you. And the entire time, it was like this digital animated birb was cheering me on to do just one more task, just one more light reflection. I could finally bring myself to do laundry in the first time in over a month. I got out of bed before noon. A paywall is nonexistent, you can do everything to help yourself without having to pay money for it, making it accessible to literally everyone. I’m not going to say this app replaces therapy, but is sure as such might as well be doing that. If you can’t access it, or you’re scared to try therapy, or simply want to try and get yourself out of a rut first, this is genuinely the perfect app. I would recommend this app to ANYONE, even if they aren’t experiencing issues with mental health. As soon as I’m able, I plan on getting Finch Plus simply to support the company, as soon as I am able. This app is incredible, and genuinely got me to enjoy waking up and getting through the day instead of feeling like I just have to survive. Thank you Finch Team for making this incredible app, I’d recommend it to everyone."
